body_lead: Telangana Government Launches AI-Powered Job Platform to Boost Youth Employment Updated: Jan 30, 2025 01:05:56pm Telangana Government Launches AI-Powered Job Platform to Boost Youth Employment Telangana, Jan 30 (KNN) In a significant step towards empowering the youth of Telangana, the state’s Industries and Commerce Department has launched the Digital Employment Exchange of Telangana (DEET). This pioneering AI-driven platform is designed to bridge the gap between job seekers and employers, facilitating internships, apprenticeships, and job opportunities tailored to individual skill sets.
